name: Beef Burger with Balsamic BBQ Sauce, Portobello Mushrooms & Peppers

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, ketchup, sugar, Worcestershire, Dijon, and spices in a small saucepan; stir to combine the BBQ sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup balsamic vinegar
¾ cup ketchup
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Bring sauce to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; slice lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Place in a large bowl.
Wash, dry, and slice mushrooms into ½-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the bowl with the other veggies. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches, add veggies and cook, turning occasionally, until tender, 8-10 minutes. Transfer veggies to a large plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve bowl for the next step).
Meanwhile, mince sun-dried tomatoes and capers; place both in the reserved bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
4 ½ tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Add beef and spices to the bowl with sun-dried tomatoes and capers; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the beef mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on another plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 tbsp parsley flakes
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the veggies are done, return the grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 2-3 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.

To assemble the burgers, layer the bottom half of each bun with a patty, BBQ sauce, and a small portion of grilled veggies; close with the top half of each bun. (Reserve remaining veggies for serving.)
To serve, divide burgers and remaining veggies between plates. Enjoy!
